about: s2e02 per-episode edit choices (S13 editor, 26 Nov, first edit). Inputs: shots.json (S7 clarity remap), script.{hi,en}.json, voice/manifest.jsonl + review.json, sound/cues.json, sound/manifest.jsonl, frames/review.json.
notes: First edit (S13, 26 Nov). Camera moves come from shots.json; second framings and the two reused s2e01 frames (s01 <- s2e01 s36, s09 <- s2e01 s14) render from their source images.

Slate: s11 (scene-B anchor). frames/review.json rejects attempt 1 (second pair of cuffs in Nirala's hand); attempt 2 is on disk (frames/manifest.jsonl) but has no review row, so the build slates it until S9 adds a retake-check row. No frame was generated or judged here. ov_token_8 (s11) is not drawn for the same reason.

cut_on_word copied from shots.json (S7 remap, cut_anchors): l08 s08->s09 on hi 'shield' / en 'the'; l15 s15->s16 on 'lockup'; l17 s19->s20 on hi 'त्रिपाठी' / en 'Cheaper'. 'shot' names the later shot, as build_timeline.py reads it. l15's cut word is placed by grapheme spread in both languages (no whisper match for that segment); l08 and l17 by whisper stamps.

Tails: s09 24 (S7: the insert then reads about 1.9 s); s33 18 (b10's 0.6 s after l30, Pushpa's steps out); s12 30 (cue sheet editor_notes: the stamp and receipt tear sit after l37, before the cut to s13); s39 2 (b12: hard cut to black on the last word of l34, then end_black).

s12 (top-down counter insert, l12, l36, l37; about 10.4 s hi, 10.2 s en): shots.json has 'hold'; overridden with a slow custom push (scale 1.0 to 1.14, x 0 to -0.3, ease-in-out) toward the register and receipt so the 10 s set-up is not a still. Not watched in motion. Still past the 8 s set-up guide; flag for screening (S7 remap note: no shot may be added).

Overlays as layers (s2e01 convention): s09 uses s2e01's frames/s14.png with overlays/s14-ov_shield.png (same source and crop family as s2e01 s20). ov_shield drawn new on s34, s38 and s39 (s39 is the second framing of s38): 'ZERO CRIME' in s2e01's ink (59,36,16), AvenirNext-Bold, centred on the brass plate measured by pixel scan (s34 plate x 569-866, y 296-456; s38 plate x 977-1303, y 317-503 of 1440x2560); checked on stills only. Not drawn (dressing, left for screening): ov_fake_board (s11, s13, s16, s22, s24, s26), ov_envelope_tag (s27, spoken by l20).

Supers: su8 'position': 'upper' (in the lower third it covered Bhaiyaji's keys and hand on s18; upper sits over the ceiling beams, left of his head). su7 'until': 's34.end' so it ends on the s34 cut (2.17 s hi, 2.33 s en) instead of running 0.8 s into s35's knitting; default lower position, clear of the shield plate at the top of s34. The build still flags su7 for starting on s34 (shots.json lists ov_shield there, dressing): s34 is the only shot of l31 and the scene's first, as S7 placed it.

Sound: the cue sheet has no place entries, so every placement is written here from placement_by_beat. Absolute gains follow s2e01's levels for shared cues (amb_talkies_lobby -7 with the 8-29 s window, amb_real_thana -9, amb_projection_room -4, knitting -10/-12, peanut -12, phone lift -15, dtmf -12, stamp -6, caper bed -9 on its continuous 16-37 s stretch, tension note -16 on its steady 2-14 s stretch in two crossfaded pieces); new cues set from their manifest peak and mean levels. None of it has been listened to.

Sound deviations: mus_theme_caper_bed starts at trim 16 s (0-16 s has 1.5 s holes); b4 stamp and receipt tear after l37 (l36 and l37 now sit between l12 and l13); keyring jingle only under l16 and out of the door in b7, not under l17 (keeps the laugh and 'Cheaper...' clear); steps on gravel start 36 frames into l15 with a 40-frame fade-in (en l15 has no first split pause); amb_talkies_lobby has no +2 dB lift in the b6/b7 silences (the crossfaded loop takes no segments); sfx_cuff_chain_clink in b10 is the same take at -12 (no pitch shift); ring-back is a 0.5 s burst at -22 and the pick-up click a separate slice (trim 2.45 s) 10 frames before s38; mus_theme_warm_ending only its opening chord, fading out over the last 0.6 s of s33 (no cross-fade to the 34 s resolve, not judged by ear); amb_real_thana -10 dB from l33 to the end; everything cuts on the last frame of s39.
